title: Upstream test inventory
description: Compiler-derived denominator of upstream test obligations: every *.test.ts file in the pinned upstream tree and every describe/it/test case it declares. Regenerated by parity/interface-extractor/src/extract-test-inventory.mjs; a reviewed mapping dispositions each entry.

caseCount.description: Total statically-declared cases across all files.

dynamicCaseSiteCount.description: Total it/test sites with runtime-computed titles; each generates an unknown number of cases at run time and must be dispositioned by inspecting the source table.

sha256.description: Content hash; a change on an upstream leap re-opens the file's disposition.

dynamicCaseSites.description: Present only when the file declares it/test cases with runtime-computed titles.

id.description: Enclosing describe titles folded into the case title with a › separator.

modifiers.description: Ordered call modifiers such as each, skip, only.
